title: Evaluation under coordinate embedding
statement: Let $m,n\in\mathbb{N}$, let $e:\{0,\ldots,m-1\}\hookrightarrow\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ be an injection, and let $S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,m-1\}$ and $U\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ satisfy $e(i)\in U$ for every $i\in S$. For a decision tree $T$ on the $m$-coordinate cube with available set $S$, and every input $x\in(\mathbb{F}_2)^n$, evaluating the tree embedded along $e$ at $x$ equals evaluating $T$ on the input whose $i$th coordinate is $x_{e(i)}$.
